data.text: Checking criteria by number hit the wrong rows: I added six criteria and ran ac check 1..5, but the board's definition of done had prepended four, so 'tests written first' and 'npm test green' were ticked on a task with no tests. Same family as the KAD-N shift in bulk delete: a position is derived, and a script that counts its own additions cannot see the ones the board made. Either ac add --json could return the position it assigned, or ac check could take the criterion text.
